snippet.title: Bloodwoven - Official Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
From the creators of the stealth-horror cult hit Blood West comes a new immersive adventure set in a world built on the frozen corpse of a forgotten god. 

Hunt bloodthirsty predators, climb walls of ice, explore frozen depths, survive a cold that can kill as surely as the fangs of alien ice-age beasts, and uncover the bloody fate waiting for you under the ice.

Wishlist now and join our Discord to follow the blood, the ancient rituals, and everything still buried beneath the snow.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4660090/Bloodwoven/

Discord: https://discord.gg/Cxp8rzUSX5

See you on the hunting ground.
